name: Crystal of Awakening
summary: Two Power, and it wakes whoever was frozen in Stasis.

face.name: Crystal of Awakening

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: The Entity it is assigned to has +2 Power. If the Entity you assign this Object to was in Stasis, release it from Stasis.

face.flavor: A light inside the stone. The stone remembers it is alive.
